Their home stadium, the [[VictoriArena|Party-Rent-Arena]],{{cite web |title=Victoria Rosport |url=https://extranet.flf.lu/club/500103 |website=FLF Extranet |access-date=11 September 2025 |language=fr}} has a capacity of {{nts|1500}}.{{cite web |title=Infrastruckuren |url=https://www.fcvictoria.lu/infrastrukturen-366879v4 |website=Victoria Rosport |access-date=11 September 2025 |language=lb |trans-title=Infrastructure}} In 2005, Rosport met [[IFK Göteborg]] in the [[2005 UEFA Intertoto Cup#First round|first round of the Intertoto Cup]]. Because Rosport's stadium was not up to [[UEFA]] standards, the match was played at the national stadium, [[Stade Josy Barthel]].
